segments.text: 联邦调查局，简称FBI，是美国司法部的主要执法及调查单位，也是美国联邦政府最大的反间谍机构。根据《美国法典》第28条533款，授权司法部长“委任官员侦测反美国的罪行”，另外其它联邦的法令给予FBI权力和职责调查特定的罪行。FBI现有的调查司法权已经超过200种联邦罪行。十大通缉要犯清单从1930年起公布于众。

segments.text: The owner and cook of Dogen Hut.

When she was nineteen, she happened to stop by the soba shop and was captivated by the chilled curry soba. By day's end, she had decided to make the restaurant her new home. Married the owner at age twenty-two and they managed the establishment together. Last year, her husband of thirty years passed away. Now she safeguards the generations-old secret of chilled curry soba on her own.
She currently employs two part-timers, Masa from Midoriyama Academy, and Mohinder, an Indian exchange student.
Edited from in-game TIPS
Mizuho's maid, she is dressed up like a man to help Mizuho overcome her fear of men.
An ordinary second-year high school student.
Due to his parents getting their jobs relocated, the protagonist comes back to his birthplace after taking a 7 year leave and gets transferred to Baramon High School.
You, the protagonist, will take part in this journey by meeting several characters, which will eventually lead into diverse sorts of situations.
She is one of the "10 Warriors of the West" of Tenjin Academy.
He is the principal of Tenjin Academy. In his younger days he was a part of the "Big Four".
